'''Chris Meyers''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[August 2000 Augusta tournament (26 August)]] on 26 August 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|Profit]], according to Arthur Rhodes's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1163">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-26-augusta-georgia-8-26-00d1163/ augusta-georgia-8-26-00], DeckTech (Arthur "arthur" Rhodes, 26 August 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-08-26-augusta-georgia-8-26-00d1163/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
